index.limits: Not a rating of any product, a prevalence estimate, a root-cause finding or a certification. Each entry reports one probe on one environment. A non-reproduction does not show that a defect is absent. The reproduced entries are not a coverage guarantee, and the entries are not a comparison between vendors.

entries.invariant: A sub-agent's model context holds only its own branch: a parallel sibling's output must not appear in it

arms.label: parallel_agent counterfactual
arms.notes: The reporter's proposed fix monkeypatched (scan start = event count when the sub-agent's context was created); must show no sibling text, else INCONCLUSIVE.

entries.probe: Own probe written from the mechanism in the report: two single_turn sub-agents on one session under a ParallelAgent parent, stub models, no model call, rootless podman, network off (t1-adk-7488/probe.py, Containerfile, run.sh). It records the exact contents built for sub-agent B and checks that A had appended its output before B was built. A reporter cross-check and dev runs are in xcheck/ and out/dev-*, not counted.
entries.raw_result: Baseline 3 VALID, 0 INVALID, 0 with the sibling's text in B's contents or model request; counterfactual 3 VALID, 0 violations.
entries.counterfactual: The same probe with the reporter's proposed fix monkeypatched: no sibling text, as required.
entries.detection_limits: One harness shape (ParallelAgent, include_contents none set explicitly); the issue anchors B on a parent agent event, this probe on the root user message, and that anchor was not tested. Stub models only.
entries.uncertainty: Three trials per arm. A non-reproduction does not show the defect is absent in other harness shapes or versions. The image digest of the counted run was not recorded; the last recorded build before it (DEV-LOG run 11, 2026-10-12 20:04Z, the same probe.py) is sha256:b9358b41d9e1aaf0bc652a35367bd96e5a81b50c3a223ab9a6b85a900bc6ca72. Probe files were not under version control when the trials ran; they are archived as run (file times 2026-10-12, before the counted runs) and were first committed in a private working repository on 2026-10-17 with no change. No probe commit existed at run time. This entry is not a rating, a prevalence estimate, a root-cause finding, a coverage guarantee or a comparison between vendors.
entries.supersession: None: 2.11.0 was the latest release on 2026-10-12.

entries.invariant: With the sandbox enabled, a trivial Bash command (echo trace-ok) runs
entries.probe: Rootless podman, ubuntu:24.04 (merged-usr), apt bubblewrap, the pinned Claude Code from npm, sandbox on, one model turn (claude-haiku-4-5) asking for `echo trace-ok` (t2-claude-99680/run.py, Containerfile). Two environment controls in the same container: C1 a minimal bwrap echo, C2 the same command with the sandbox off.
entries.raw_result: 2.1.289: 3 VALID, 0 INVALID, 0 with the bwrap ENOENT failure; 2.1.296: 3 VALID, 0 INVALID, 0 violations. Controls: C1 ok, C2 ok on both versions.
entries.counterfactual: C2 (sandbox off) runs the same command as the control for the sandbox itself.
entries.detection_limits: Ubuntu 24.04 with bubblewrap 0.9.0; the reporter used Debian trixie with bubblewrap 0.12.0. A non-counted diagnostic with sandbox.failIfUnavailable=true still ran, so the sandbox was available.
entries.uncertainty: Three trials per version. A non-reproduction does not show the defect is absent on other distributions. The container image digest was not recorded. Probe files were not under version control when the trials ran; they are archived as run (file times 2026-10-12, before the counted runs) and were first committed in a private working repository on 2026-10-17 with no change. No probe commit existed at run time. This entry is not a rating, a prevalence estimate, a root-cause finding, a coverage guarantee or a comparison between vendors.

entries.invariant: With --disable multi_agent, a run must not spawn a subagent

arms.label: run A supersession
arms.notes: Launched under the label affected-0.160.0; every rollout records cli_version 0.162.1, so it is filed as the supersession arm.

entries.probe: The reporter's command with `--disable multi_agent` and -m gpt-5.6-sol, 0.160.0 on a pinned binary and 0.162.1 via the globally installed binary (version verified from every rollout), each trial in a fresh CODEX_HOME and temporary directory (t3-codex-50880/run_trial.py, run_affected.sh). A spawn counts only when a child rollout names that trial's own exec thread as its parent; a child bound to another parent is INVALID.
entries.raw_result: 0.160.0: 5 VALID, 0 INVALID, 5 genuine spawns; counterfactual 2 VALID, 0 spawns. 0.162.1: 5 VALID, 5 genuine spawns; counterfactual 2 VALID, 0 spawns. Run B was a harness failure with zero Codex invocations (out/runB*).
entries.counterfactual: 2 trials with -c 'features.multi_agent_v2={enabled=false, max_concurrent_threads_per_session=1}', expected to refuse the spawn: the attempt returned "agent thread limit reached" and no child rollout exists.
entries.detection_limits: One account and model (gpt-5.6-sol); the child is detected from local rollout files, not from the service.
entries.uncertainty: Five VALID trials per arm. A reproduction shows the invariant can break on this version here; it says nothing about how often or why. Probe files were not under version control when the trials ran; they are archived as run (file times 2026-10-12, before the counted runs) and were first committed in a private working repository on 2026-10-17 with no change. No probe commit existed at run time. This entry is not a rating, a prevalence estimate, a root-cause finding, a coverage guarantee or a comparison between vendors.
entries.supersession: Present in the latest release tested: 0.162.1 showed 5 of 5 genuine spawns.
